awards.name: Hong Kong Scholarship for Excellence Scheme (HKSES) — postgraduate
awards.scope: Any world-renowned university outside HK (US incl.)
awards.description: HKSAR Government (EDB) scheme supporting outstanding local students to study outside Hong Kong; primarily undergraduate but postgraduate (master's/doctoral) applicants are eligible.
awards.eligibility: Right of abode / right to land in HK (or entered on One-way Permit) AND resided in HK continuously for 3 complete years before programme start. Postgraduate applicants may hold undergraduate degrees from inside or outside HK. Programme must start Aug 2027–Jul 2028. Scheme 'will primarily benefit students pursuing studies at undergraduate level'. Taiwan: not applicable.
awards.amount: Non-means-tested scholarship covering tuition 'subject to a ceiling of HK$300,000 per annum'; means-tested bursary 'subject to a ceiling of HK$200,000 per student per annum'. Master's: up to two years. Up to 100 offers per cohort.

awards.name: Croucher Scholarships for Doctoral Study
awards.description: Croucher Foundation (HK private foundation) full PhD scholarships in natural sciences, technology and medicine. PhD only — not MS CS / MBA.
awards.eligibility: Hong Kong permanent residents; full-time doctoral study/research outside HK in natural sciences, medicine or technology. Taiwan: not applicable. Not for master's or MBA.
awards.amount: USD38,850 per annum maintenance; tuition and college fees; airfare; USD1,000 arrival; up to USD2,000/yr academic development; up to USD2,000/yr medical; USD9,700 commencement award (verbatim, 2027 Study Awards notice)

awards.name: Fulbright Taiwan (FSE) Graduate Study Award
awards.scope: Any US institution (IIE placement, up to 5) + Rice PhD partner
awards.description: Taiwan Fulbright commission award for Taiwanese to pursue US master's or doctoral degrees; this is the Taiwan route of SCH-001.
awards.eligibility: Physically present in Taiwan Aug 2026–Jul 2027; bachelor's by June 2027 and ready to enroll Fall 2027; iBT ≥80 / IELTS ≥6.5 (master's), iBT ≥100 / IELTS ≥7.0 (doctoral); GRE/GMAT. Fields incl. STEM and Business. Hong Kong: not applicable. Citizenship wording beyond residency: see page (unclear here).
awards.amount: Monthly stipend of US$2,831 to US$4,300 for 12 months (renewable for 2nd year); one-time settling allowance US$3,000; up to 9 awards (All Institutions)
awards.deadline: August 1, 2026 (Fall 2027 cycle — closed); next cycle unknown

awards.name: Taiwan MOE Government Scholarship to Study Abroad (GSSA 留學獎學金) — general
awards.description: Taiwan Ministry of Education merit scholarship selected by document review; applicants must already hold an admission letter.
awards.eligibility: ROC nationals with household registration in Taiwan; ≤45; admission from a recognised foreign university. General students: doctoral degree only (except arts/architecture/New Southbound countries). Hong Kong: not applicable. So MS CS / MBA NOT eligible under general category.
awards.amount: General students: US$16,000 per year, max 2 years (115/2026 brochure)
awards.deadline: 2026 (115) cycle: 16 Jan–13 Feb 2026 (latest published); 2027 cycle unknown

awards.name: Taiwan MOE GSSA — 勵學優秀生 (low-income category)
awards.description: Need-based category of the MOE study-abroad scholarship; master's OR doctoral allowed.
awards.eligibility: Same base eligibility as GSSA plus valid municipal low-income or middle-low-income household certificate. Master's or PhD in any field (so MS CS / MBA eligible). 10 places (2026). Hong Kong: not applicable.
awards.amount: US$30,000 per year, max 3 years (115/2026 brochure; same rate for indigenous and disability categories)

awards.name: Taiwan MOE Study Abroad Public Scholarship Exam (公費留學考試)
awards.description: Taiwan national government-funded study-abroad exam; 2027 exam: 83 fields, 201 places, 25 fields AI-related; switching to document review + interview.
awards.eligibility: Taiwan nationals (details in 2027 brochure, due first half of 2027). 2026 trusted-industry fields (AI, ICT, cybersecurity, semiconductors etc.) were doctoral. Degree level for 2027 fields: unclear until brochure. Hong Kong: not applicable.
awards.amount: 2026 (115) cycle: tuition total cap US$120,000 over 3 years (trusted-industry fields); living allowance up to US$28,000/yr (e.g. NYC, Cambridge MA, SF, Stanford, Berkeley)
awards.deadline: 2026 cycle registration 15–31 Jul 2026; 2027 cycle dates unknown (brochure H1 2027)

awards.name: Taiwan NSTC Graduate Students Study Abroad Program (千里馬計畫)
awards.scope: Research visit abroad for Taiwan-enrolled PhD students
awards.description: NSTC partial grant for PhD students enrolled in Taiwan to do 7–12 months research abroad. NOT degree funding for US master's/MBA — included for completeness.
awards.eligibility: Doctoral students in Taiwan universities. Hong Kong: not applicable.
awards.amount: Partial support calculated at NT$900,000 per year, pro-rated by days abroad (7–12 months)
